rules.text: Each instrument variant needs separate proficiency. Ability Charisma. Utilize: play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15). Tool proficiency adds PB; also having the used skill proficiency grants Advantage. A Bard can use a Musical Instrument as a focus for Bard spells (Bard candidate owns permission).
